skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain basic concepts, nature, importance, and characteristics of tourism destinations and destination management organizations (DMOs).
Analyze and develop strategic plans for tourism destinations including macro-environment analysis, competitive analysis, vision setting, and solution development.
Understand and apply branding principles for tourism destinations including positioning, brand building, market segmentation, and target market selection.
Apply marketing mix strategies for tourism destinations including product, price, promotion, and distribution strategies.
Manage customer experience at tourism destinations by ensuring service quality standards, managing tourists, developing human resources, and engaging with communities.
Evaluate and promote sustainable tourism development including environmental, social, and economic sustainability.
Analyze components of tourism destinations and their environments.
Conduct competitive environment analysis for tourism destinations.
Utilize online and offline marketing tools for tourism destinations.
Proactively engage in self-study, continuous learning, and innovation.
Demonstrate responsible behavior towards regulations and actively participate in destination development activities.
